**Key design choices to flag for DOS:R13:**

- **Requirement payload discipline**: stored as `type='requirement'` + `payload.kind === 'requirement-item'` with the lowercase `RequirementPayload`-aligned fields plus `kind` + `id`. The cast through `as unknown as RequirementPayload` is the same trick the PRD layer uses (`payload.kind === 'prd'`). `contracts/src/memory.ts` was NOT touched this session.
- **`verificationStatus` is derived, not stored.** Host computes `'empty'` when `verificationCriteria?.length === 0`, `'draft'` otherwise. CHUNK-08 owns the `'draft' → 'approved'` transition and will write `verificationCriteria` into the payload. The `'approved'` status is reserved — no code path writes it yet.
- **`Requirement.entryId`** (UUID) is exposed alongside `id` (REQ-NNN) so the webview's update/delete handlers can address the SQLite row directly. This was added during Day 4 — if any future caller needs to look REQ-NNN → entryId server-side, walk the catalogue from `RequirementsList`.
- **`RequirementsDeps` injects `openDecomposePanel`** as a callback. Cleaner than passing `vscode.ExtensionContext` through; mirrors the same pattern the messenger should use for any future panel-open-from-handler need.
- **`derives-from` link kind** points from the requirement-item entry → the PRD entry (matching the PRD's own `derives-from` link to the intent). `listRequirementItems(prdId)` joins through this link to filter.
- **Tree command argument shape**: per-REQ click passes `{ selectedId: REQ-NNN }` to `deliveryos.requirements.open`. The host's `requirementsPanel.ts` has a `consumePendingRequirementSelection()` hook to deliver this to the webview on bootstrap, but the webview-side wiring isn't done — currently a no-op deep link. Easy follow-up for DOS:R13 if dogfooding wants it.

Status enum returns must use `as const` on the literal — `as const` propagated all the way through; raw `string` widening will break the union.
